text.help.body:
1. Add managed directories on the Directory page; the app will scan and index them.
2. On the Tags page, create types first, then tags under each type; tags can have colors.
3. On the Files page, drag tags onto files to assign them; the filter area supports Include / Exclude / Only conditions.
4. On the Sync page, you can start a server or connect to other TagMeow instances on the LAN.
5. Changes in Settings (language / theme / font size / storage mode) are written to config.json immediately.

text.browse.level_hint: Double-click: enter directory / open file with system default; Right-click: more actions

text.browse.empty_level: No displayable content in this directory

text.sync.server_off_hint: Server is not running; start the server before adding directories

text.confirm.remove_dir: Remove this managed directory? It will only be removed from the list; files on disk will not be touched.

text.confirm.refresh_dir: Rescan this directory? The index records for this directory will be rebuilt based on the current disk state (disk files will not be touched).

text.confirm.remove_type: Delete this type? Tags under this type will also be removed.

text.confirm.remove_tag: Delete this tag? Records assigned to files will also be removed.

text.confirm.convert_mode: Convert storage mode? All managed files will be batch-rewritten (Sidecar <-> Filename).

text.confirm.refresh_index: Refresh the index? All managed directories will be rescanned and index records rebuilt (disk files will not be touched).

text.confirm.cleanup: Clear invalid data? Only records in the database that no longer exist on disk will be deleted; disk files will not be touched at all.

text.confirm.rename_type: Rename this type? Tags under this type will be renamed as well.
